sources.label: Argentina Ministry of Health Annual HIV Notifications
sources.description: Argentina Ministry of Health annual HIV notifications, 2014–2023. Each value is the source's explicit national ARG / 200 total for Ambos sexos; province and sex rows are not added. Notifications are not estimates of incident infections, prevalence or AIDS cases. Annual dates denote calendar years, not individual event dates; unknown values stay unknown. CC BY 4.0 is declared by the official resource metadata. The catalogue's older package description differs from the selected 2014–2023 resource. No 2024–2026 observations are supplied by this resource. BEN cumulative notifications remain a separate source and do not enter this curve.
sources.description_zh: 来源：阿根廷国家卫生部，2014–2023 年 HIV 年度通知数。每个数值直接取自来源明确给出的 ARG／200 全国、Ambos sexos 双性别合计行，不累加省份或性别分项。通知数不等于新感染估计、患病存量或 AIDS 病例；年度日期表示自然年，不是个案发生日期，未知值保持未知。官方资源元数据声明 CC BY 4.0；目录包较早的描述与所选 2014–2023 年原件范围不同。该资源尚无 2024–2026 年观测。BEN 累计通知保持独立来源，不混入本曲线。
sources.description_fr: Notifications annuelles de VIH du ministère argentin de la Santé, 2014–2023. Chaque valeur est le total national explicite ARG / 200 pour Ambos sexos ; les provinces et les sexes ne sont pas additionnés. Ces notifications ne mesurent ni les nouvelles infections estimées, ni la prévalence, ni les cas de sida. Les dates désignent des années civiles, pas des dates individuelles ; les valeurs inconnues restent inconnues. Les métadonnées officielles de la ressource déclarent CC BY 4.0. L'ancienne description du catalogue diffère de la ressource 2014–2023 sélectionnée, qui ne fournit aucune observation pour 2024–2026. Les cumuls BEN restent une source séparée, exclue de cette courbe.
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Salud de la Nación Argentina
sources.required_attribution: Ministerio de Salud de la Nación Argentina, Casos notificados de VIH por año y jurisdicción, 2014–2023, national ARG / 200, Ambos sexos. CC BY 4.0. sources.description_zh: 2007–2022 年按发生地市镇、事件及周汇总的数据，并非官方全国周表。全国加总及周历边界须另行核验。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA successor municipality records (2022–2024)
sources.description: Separate successor open table covering 2022–2024; ingestion uses 2023–2024 and excludes the 2022 overlap. No 2025 or 2026 rows were present in the checked release. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation coverage.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 后续市镇周汇总（2022–2024）
sources.description_zh: 独立的后续开放表，实际覆盖 2022–2024 年；采集采用 2023–2024 年并排除重复的 2022 年。已检查版本没有 2025 或 2026 年数据，元数据更新时间不代表数据覆盖至今。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA annual microdata (through 2025)
sources.description: Annual workbooks through 2025; no 2026 workbook in the checked catalogue. Weekly aggregates derived from individual records retain source case classifications and foreign/unknown occurrence separately. Collective forms require event-specific measures. Derived notification counts are not a published INS national incidence table.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 年度微观数据（截至 2025）
sources.description_zh: 按统计年度发布的工作簿，已检查目录截至 2025 年，没有 2026 年表。个案按原始年周聚合，保留病例分类及境外、未知发生地；集体表须按事件核验指标。这是个案衍生的通知记录数，并非 INS 发布的全国周发病表。

sources.label: INS BES weekly bulletins (cumulative annex and weekly evidence)
sources.description: Reviewed body-table weekly notifications only. Annex year-to-date snapshots are separate and never weekly incidence; early issues without an explicit weekly definition remain gaps.
sources.label_zh: INS BES 周报（累计附录与当周证据）

sources.label: INS event reports and surveillance methods

sources.description_fr: Les notifications nationales mensuelles du rapport 506 conservent la définition source, principalement des cas suspects. Elles restent distinctes des semaines de début et de notification DDS ; les périodes absentes restent inconnues. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

sources.description: Report 506 national monthly notifications retain the source's mostly suspected case definition. sources.description_zh: Report 506 全国月度报告数保留来源以疑似病例为主的定义；月度报告数与 DDS 发病周、报告周数据分别保留，缺失期间保持未知。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les notifications nationales mensuelles du rapport 506 conservent la définition source, principalement des cas suspects. Elles restent distinctes des semaines de début et de notification DDS ; les périodes absentes restent inconnues. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

sources.required_attribution: Thailand Ministry of Public Health, Department of Disease Control, Thailand DOE Report 506 Monthly History. Original source: https://doe.moph.go.th/surdata/. Source definitions and reporting periods retained.

Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

ICD revisions and source definitions are retained; rates, age/sex strata and subnational rows do not replace or add to national totals. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.
sources.description_zh: 展示已审核的全国、全年龄、全性别年度新报告病例总数，保留 ICD 版本及来源定义；率、年龄／性别分层和地方行不替代或累加到全国总数。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les totaux annuels nationaux examinés couvrent tous les âges et sexes. Les versions de la CIM et définitions sources sont conservées ; taux, strates et lignes infranationales ne remplacent ni ne complètent les totaux nationaux. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

sources.label: Malaysia WHO GHO Annual Reported Infections
sources.description: WHO, Malaysia WHO GHO Annual Reported Infections; country-reported annual indicators, accessed 2026-11-16. Original indicator titles, observed years, values and missing states are retained with each source series. Only the 18 reviewed count indicators are eligible; actual categories and available years vary by country. Annual data may lag and do not establish complete national surveillance coverage. WHO dataset terms permit public-health use with attribution; restrictions include commercial promotion, misrepresentation and implied endorsement. This independent presentation does not imply WHO endorsement. Terms: https://www.who.int/about/policies/publishing/data-policy/terms-and-conditions

Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

sources.description: Santé publique France, French Guiana SPF ODISSE Annual Notifications, extracted 2026-11-16. Licence ouverte 2.0, declared by the five source dataset metadata records. TB notification-location observations through 2018 and residence-location observations from 2019 have separate definitions: the representative curve may use only the residence series, with older data retained in source details. Monthly reporting counts stay separate from DDS onset-week and report-week data; missing source periods remain unknown. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS weekly counts use onset date and place. They remain separate from report-date DDS Tableau and Report 506 monthly counts; only the reviewed onset definition is eligible. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS Tableau weekly counts use report date and place. They are a distinct source definition from onset-week DDS and monthly Report 506; the series are not combined into an additive total. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.

sources.description_zh: Report 506 全国月度报告数保留来源以疑似病例为主的定义；月度报告数与 DDS 发病周、报告周数据分别保留，缺失期间保持未知。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les notifications nationales mensuelles du rapport 506 conservent la définition source, principalement des cas suspects. Elles restent distinctes des semaines de début et de notification DDS ; les périodes absentes restent inconnues. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

sources.description_zh: 仅展示已审核 NMC 当前报告月全国全部通知计数，保留来源通知窗口；排除队列比较和患者状态分项，不将患者死亡状态视作当月发生的死亡。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Seuls les comptes nationaux NMC examinés de toutes les notifications du mois courant sont présentés, avec leur fenêtre source. Comparaisons de cohortes et sous-groupes par statut sont exclus ; le statut de décès ne devient pas un décès survenu ce mois-là. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

sources.description: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16. The official CKAN catalogue declares CC0. Only reviewed confirmed national annual notification aggregates are presented; individual case rows are not released. The current CSV covers 2007–2024 and a changed disease inventory, while the catalogue text and methodology PDF still describe 2007–2022 and older exclusions. This upstream discrepancy is retained in the source audit; the older PDF is not asserted to describe the current CSV. Notification year is not onset year. Source-system periods and classifications remain separate; absent disease-years are unknown.

source_info.notes: Report 506 national monthly notifications retain the source's mostly suspected case definition. Monthly reporting counts stay separate from DDS onset-week and report-week data; missing source periods remain unknown. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS weekly counts use onset date and place. They remain separate from report-date DDS Tableau and Report 506 monthly counts; only the reviewed onset definition is eligible. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS Tableau weekly counts use report date and place. They are a distinct source definition from onset-week DDS and monthly Report 506; the series are not combined into an additive total. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.

sources.description_zh: Report 506 全国月度报告数保留来源以疑似病例为主的定义；月度报告数与 DDS 发病周、报告周数据分别保留，缺失期间保持未知。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les notifications nationales mensuelles du rapport 506 conservent la définition source, principalement des cas suspects. Elles restent distinctes des semaines de début et de notification DDS ; les périodes absentes restent inconnues. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

sources.description_zh: 已审核全国 DDS 周度计数按发病日期及地点统计，与按报告日期统计的 DDS Tableau 及 Report 506 月度计数分别保留；仅采用已审核的发病口径。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les nombres hebdomadaires nationaux DDS examinés suivent la date et le lieu de début. Ils restent distincts du Tableau DDS par notification et des comptes mensuels du rapport 506 ; seule la définition examinée est retenue. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

sources.description_fr: Seuls les comptes nationaux NMC examinés de toutes les notifications du mois courant sont présentés, avec leur fenêtre source. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

source_info.notes: Report 506 national monthly notifications retain the source's mostly suspected case definition. Monthly reporting counts stay separate from DDS onset-week and report-week data; missing source periods remain unknown. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS weekly counts use onset date and place. They remain separate from report-date DDS Tableau and Report 506 monthly counts; only the reviewed onset definition is eligible. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS Tableau weekly counts use report date and place. They are a distinct source definition from onset-week DDS and monthly Report 506; the series are not combined into an additive total. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.

sources.description: WHO, Viet Nam WHO GHO Annual Reported Infections; country-reported annual indicators, accessed 2026-11-16. Original indicator titles, observed years, values and missing states are retained with each source series. Only the 18 reviewed count indicators are eligible; actual categories and available years vary by country. Annual data may lag and do not establish complete national surveillance coverage. WHO dataset terms permit public-health use with attribution; restrictions include commercial promotion, misrepresentation and implied endorsement. This independent presentation does not imply WHO endorsement. Terms: https://www.who.int/about/policies/publishing/data-policy/terms-and-conditions

source_info.notes: No same-structure national weekly open table exists for 2025–2026. Municipality products cover 2007–2022 and 2022–2024; selected BES weekly notifications, BES YTD snapshots, annual microdata and WHO laboratory detections remain independent, with different definitions and calendars.

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA municipality records (2007–2022)
sources.description: Historical municipality-of-occurrence event/week counts, 2007–2022. These are not an official national weekly table. National aggregation and dated week boundaries require separate validation.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 市镇周汇总（2007–2022）
sources.description_zh: 2007–2022 年按发生地市镇、事件及周汇总的数据，并非官方全国周表。全国加总及周历边界须另行核验。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA successor municipality records (2022–2024)
sources.description: Separate successor open table covering 2022–2024; ingestion uses 2023–2024 and excludes the 2022 overlap. No 2025 or 2026 rows were present in the checked release. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation coverage.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 后续市镇周汇总（2022–2024）
sources.description_zh: 独立的后续开放表，实际覆盖 2022–2024 年；采集采用 2023–2024 年并排除重复的 2022 年。已检查版本没有 2025 或 2026 年数据，元数据更新时间不代表数据覆盖至今。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA annual microdata (through 2025)
sources.description: Annual workbooks through 2025; no 2026 workbook in the checked catalogue. Weekly aggregates derived from individual records retain source case classifications and foreign/unknown occurrence separately. Collective forms require event-specific measures. Derived notification counts are not a published INS national incidence table.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 年度微观数据（截至 2025）
sources.description_zh: 按统计年度发布的工作簿，已检查目录截至 2025 年，没有 2026 年表。个案按原始年周聚合，保留病例分类及境外、未知发生地；集体表须按事件核验指标。这是个案衍生的通知记录数，并非 INS 发布的全国周发病表。

sources.label: INS BES weekly bulletins (cumulative annex and weekly evidence)
sources.description: Reviewed body-table weekly notifications only. Annex year-to-date snapshots are separate and never weekly incidence; early issues without an explicit weekly definition remain gaps.
sources.label_zh: INS BES 周报（累计附录与当周证据）
sources.description_zh: 仅展示正文中明确单周定义的通知数。附录 Acumulado 累计数单独保存，不作周发病数；早期缺少明确周定义的报告保持缺口。

sources.label: INS event reports and surveillance methods

An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.
sources.description_zh: 仅展示已审核健康概况正文中明确标为全国的年度病例总数；附表列、率、登记存量及分类分项不替代全国病例总数。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Seuls les totaux annuels nationaux explicites des tableaux narratifs examinés du profil sanitaire sont présentés. Les annexes, taux, stocks enregistrés et sous-catégories ne remplacent pas les totaux nationaux. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

Les versions de la CIM et définitions sources sont conservées ; taux, strates et lignes infranationales ne remplacent ni ne complètent les totaux nationaux. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

Monthly reporting counts stay separate from DDS onset-week and report-week data; missing source periods remain unknown. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS weekly counts use onset date and place. They remain separate from report-date DDS Tableau and Report 506 monthly counts; only the reviewed onset definition is eligible. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS Tableau weekly counts use report date and place. They are a distinct source definition from onset-week DDS and monthly Report 506; the series are not combined into an additive total. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.

sources.description_zh: Report 506 全国月度报告数保留来源以疑似病例为主的定义；月度报告数与 DDS 发病周、报告周数据分别保留，缺失期间保持未知。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les notifications nationales mensuelles du rapport 506 conservent la définition source, principalement des cas suspects. Elles restent distinctes des semaines de début et de notification DDS ; les périodes absentes restent inconnues. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

sources.description_zh: 仅展示已审核 NMC 当前报告月全国全部通知计数，保留来源通知窗口；排除队列比较和患者状态分项，不将患者死亡状态视作当月发生的死亡。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Seuls les comptes nationaux NMC examinés de toutes les notifications du mois courant sont présentés, avec leur fenêtre source. Comparaisons de cohortes et sous-groupes par statut sont exclus ; le statut de décès ne devient pas un décès survenu ce mois-là. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

source_info.notes: No same-structure national weekly open table exists for 2025–2026. Municipality products cover 2007–2022 and 2022–2024; selected BES weekly notifications, BES YTD snapshots, annual microdata and WHO laboratory detections remain independent, with different definitions and calendars.

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA municipality records (2007–2022)
sources.description: Historical municipality-of-occurrence event/week counts, 2007–2022. These are not an official national weekly table. National aggregation and dated week boundaries require separate validation.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 市镇周汇总（2007–2022）
sources.description_zh: 2007–2022 年按发生地市镇、事件及周汇总的数据，并非官方全国周表。全国加总及周历边界须另行核验。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA successor municipality records (2022–2024)
sources.description: Separate successor open table covering 2022–2024; ingestion uses 2023–2024 and excludes the 2022 overlap. No 2025 or 2026 rows were present in the checked release. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation coverage.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 后续市镇周汇总（2022–2024）
sources.description_zh: 独立的后续开放表，实际覆盖 2022–2024 年；采集采用 2023–2024 年并排除重复的 2022 年。已检查版本没有 2025 或 2026 年数据，元数据更新时间不代表数据覆盖至今。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA annual microdata (through 2025)
sources.description: Annual workbooks through 2025; no 2026 workbook in the checked catalogue. Weekly aggregates derived from individual records retain source case classifications and foreign/unknown occurrence separately. Collective forms require event-specific measures. Derived notification counts are not a published INS national incidence table.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 年度微观数据（截至 2025）
sources.description_zh: 按统计年度发布的工作簿，已检查目录截至 2025 年，没有 2026 年表。个案按原始年周聚合，保留病例分类及境外、未知发生地；集体表须按事件核验指标。这是个案衍生的通知记录数，并非 INS 发布的全国周发病表。

sources.label: INS BES weekly bulletins (cumulative annex and weekly evidence)
sources.description: Reviewed body-table weekly notifications only. Annex year-to-date snapshots are separate and never weekly incidence; early issues without an explicit weekly definition remain gaps.
sources.label_zh: INS BES 周报（累计附录与当周证据）
sources.description_zh: 仅展示正文中明确单周定义的通知数。附录 Acumulado 累计数单独保存，不作周发病数；早期缺少明确周定义的报告保持缺口。

sources.label: INS event reports and surveillance methods
sources.description: Event-specific annual and epidemiological-period reports supply definitions and reconciliation evidence. They do not provide a complete multi-disease national weekly table and are not merged automatically.
sources.label_zh: INS 单事件报告与监测方法
sources.description_zh: 按事件发布的年报及流行病学周期报告，用于核对病例定义、统计口径及总数，并非完整的全病种全国周表，不自动拼接为周曲线。

sources.label: WHO FluNet Colombia weekly laboratory detections
sources.description: Weekly respiratory laboratory detections; sentinel and nonsentinel retained separately, not national incident patient cases.
sources.label_zh: WHO FluNet 哥伦比亚实验室周检出数
sources.description_zh: 呼吸道实验室每周检出数；哨点与非哨点分别展示，不能解释为全国新发病例。

sources.description: Only reviewed current monthly all-notified national NMC counts are presented, retaining the source notification window. sources.description_zh: 仅展示已审核 NMC 当前报告月全国全部通知计数，保留来源通知窗口；排除队列比较和患者状态分项，不将患者死亡状态视作当月发生的死亡。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Seuls les comptes nationaux NMC examinés de toutes les notifications du mois courant sont présentés, avec leur fenêtre source. Comparaisons de cohortes et sous-groupes par statut sont exclus ; le statut de décès ne devient pas un décès survenu ce mois-là. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

sources.required_attribution: National Institute for Communicable Diseases (NICD), South Africa, South Africa NICD NMC. Original source: https://www.nicd.ac.za/nmc-overview/nmc-monthly-surveillance-report/. Source definitions and reporting periods retained.

Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

source_info.notes: Report 506 national monthly notifications retain the source's mostly suspected case definition. Monthly reporting counts stay separate from DDS onset-week and report-week data; missing source periods remain unknown. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS weekly counts use onset date and place. They remain separate from report-date DDS Tableau and Report 506 monthly counts; only the reviewed onset definition is eligible. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS Tableau weekly counts use report date and place. They are a distinct source definition from onset-week DDS and monthly Report 506; the series are not combined into an additive total. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.

sources.description: Report 506 national monthly notifications retain the source's mostly suspected case definition. Monthly reporting counts stay separate from DDS onset-week and report-week data; missing source periods remain unknown. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. sources.description_zh: Report 506 全国月度报告数保留来源以疑似病例为主的定义；月度报告数与 DDS 发病周、报告周数据分别保留，缺失期间保持未知。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les notifications nationales mensuelles du rapport 506 conservent la définition source, principalement des cas suspects. Elles restent distinctes des semaines de début et de notification DDS ; les périodes absentes restent inconnues. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.
sources.publisher: Thailand Ministry of Public Health, Department of Disease Control
sources.required_attribution: Thailand Ministry of Public Health, Department of Disease Control, Thailand DOE Report 506 Monthly History. Original source: https://doe.moph.go.th/surdata/. Source definitions and reporting periods retained.

sources.label: Thailand DDS Weekly Onset Notifications
sources.description: Reviewed national DDS weekly counts use onset date and place. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

sources.description: Only reviewed current monthly all-notified national NMC counts are presented, retaining the source notification window. Cohort comparisons and patient-status subsets are excluded; patient death status is not treated as deaths occurring in that month. sources.description_zh: 仅展示已审核 NMC 当前报告月全国全部通知计数，保留来源通知窗口；排除队列比较和患者状态分项，不将患者死亡状态视作当月发生的死亡。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Seuls les comptes nationaux NMC examinés de toutes les notifications du mois courant sont présentés, avec leur fenêtre source. Comparaisons de cohortes et sous-groupes par statut sont exclus ; le statut de décès ne devient pas un décès survenu ce mois-là. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

sources.description_fr: Les notifications nationales mensuelles du rapport 506 conservent la définition source, principalement des cas suspects. Elles restent distinctes des semaines de début et de notification DDS ; les périodes absentes restent inconnues. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

sources.description: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16. The official CKAN catalogue declares CC0. Only reviewed confirmed national annual notification aggregates are presented; individual case rows are not released. The current CSV covers 2007–2024 and a changed disease inventory, while the catalogue text and methodology PDF still describe 2007–2022 and older exclusions. This upstream discrepancy is retained in the source audit; the older PDF is not asserted to describe the current CSV. Notification year is not onset year. Source-system periods and classifications remain separate; absent disease-years are unknown.

sources.publisher: Ministerio de Salud de Chile

sources.description: WHO, Malaysia WHO GHO Annual Reported Infections; country-reported annual indicators, accessed 2026-11-16. Original indicator titles, observed years, values and missing states are retained with each source series. Only the 18 reviewed count indicators are eligible; actual categories and available years vary by country. Annual data may lag and do not establish complete national surveillance coverage. WHO dataset terms permit public-health use with attribution; restrictions include commercial promotion, misrepresentation and implied endorsement. This independent presentation does not imply WHO endorsement. Terms: https://www.who.int/about/policies/publishing/data-policy/terms-and-conditions

source_info.notes: Report 506 national monthly notifications retain the source's mostly suspected case definition. Monthly reporting counts stay separate from DDS onset-week and report-week data; missing source periods remain unknown. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS weekly counts use onset date and place. They remain separate from report-date DDS Tableau and Report 506 monthly counts; only the reviewed onset definition is eligible. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS Tableau weekly counts use report date and place. They are a distinct source definition from onset-week DDS and monthly Report 506; the series are not combined into an additive total. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.

sources.description: Report 506 national monthly notifications retain the source's mostly suspected case definition. sources.description_zh: Report 506 全国月度报告数保留来源以疑似病例为主的定义；月度报告数与 DDS 发病周、报告周数据分别保留，缺失期间保持未知。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les notifications nationales mensuelles du rapport 506 conservent la définition source, principalement des cas suspects. Elles restent distinctes des semaines de début et de notification DDS ; les périodes absentes restent inconnues. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

sources.description_zh: 已审核全国 DDS 周度计数按发病日期及地点统计，与按报告日期统计的 DDS Tableau 及 Report 506 月度计数分别保留；仅采用已审核的发病口径。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les nombres hebdomadaires nationaux DDS examinés suivent la date et le lieu de début. Ils restent distincts du Tableau DDS par notification et des comptes mensuels du rapport 506 ; seule la définition examinée est retenue. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

sources.description: WHO, Malaysia WHO GHO Annual Reported Infections; country-reported annual indicators, accessed 2026-11-16. Original indicator titles, observed years, values and missing states are retained with each source series. Only the 18 reviewed count indicators are eligible; actual categories and available years vary by country. Annual data may lag and do not establish complete national surveillance coverage. WHO dataset terms permit public-health use with attribution; restrictions include commercial promotion, misrepresentation and implied endorsement. This independent presentation does not imply WHO endorsement. Terms: https://www.who.int/about/policies/publishing/data-policy/terms-and-conditions

source_info.notes: Report 506 national monthly notifications retain the source's mostly suspected case definition. Monthly reporting counts stay separate from DDS onset-week and report-week data; missing source periods remain unknown. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS weekly counts use onset date and place. They remain separate from report-date DDS Tableau and Report 506 monthly counts; only the reviewed onset definition is eligible. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS Tableau weekly counts use report date and place. They are a distinct source definition from onset-week DDS and monthly Report 506; the series are not combined into an additive total. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.

sources.label: Thailand DOE Report 506 Monthly History
sources.description: Report 506 national monthly notifications retain the source's mostly suspected case definition. Monthly reporting counts stay separate from DDS onset-week and report-week data; missing source periods remain unknown. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.
sources.description_zh: Report 506 全国月度报告数保留来源以疑似病例为主的定义；月度报告数与 DDS 发病周、报告周数据分别保留，缺失期间保持未知。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les notifications nationales mensuelles du rapport 506 conservent la définition source, principalement des cas suspects. Elles restent distinctes des semaines de début et de notification DDS ; les périodes absentes restent inconnues. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.
sources.publisher: Thailand Ministry of Public Health, Department of Disease Control
sources.required_attribution: Thailand Ministry of Public Health, Department of Disease Control, Thailand DOE Report 506 Monthly History. Original source: https://doe.moph.go.th/surdata/. Source definitions and reporting periods retained.

sources.label: Thailand DDS Weekly Onset Notifications
sources.description: Reviewed national DDS weekly counts use onset date and place. They remain separate from report-date DDS Tableau and Report 506 monthly counts; only the reviewed onset definition is eligible. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.
sources.description_zh: 已审核全国 DDS 周度计数按发病日期及地点统计，与按报告日期统计的 DDS Tableau 及 Report 506 月度计数分别保留；仅采用已审核的发病口径。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les nombres hebdomadaires nationaux DDS examinés suivent la date et le lieu de début. Ils restent distincts du Tableau DDS par notification et des comptes mensuels du rapport 506 ; seule la définition examinée est retenue. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

sources.label: Chile MINSAL Historical ENO Notifications
sources.description: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16. The official CKAN catalogue declares CC0. Only reviewed confirmed national annual notification aggregates are presented; individual case rows are not released. The current CSV covers 2007–2024 and a changed disease inventory, while the catalogue text and methodology PDF still describe 2007–2022 and older exclusions. This upstream discrepancy is retained in the source audit; the older PDF is not asserted to describe the current CSV. Notification year is not onset year. Source-system periods and classifications remain separate; absent disease-years are unknown.

sources.description: Czechia annual Member-State reported case counts from the ECDC Surveillance Atlas. Missing topic/year cells remain unknown and published zeroes are preserved. Data provided by ECDC based on data reported by EU/EEA Member States.

source_info.notes: Only reviewed current monthly all-notified national NMC counts are presented, retaining the source notification window. Cohort comparisons and patient-status subsets are excluded; patient death status is not treated as deaths occurring in that month. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.

sources.label: South Africa NICD NMC
sources.description: Only reviewed current monthly all-notified national NMC counts are presented, retaining the source notification window. Cohort comparisons and patient-status subsets are excluded; patient death status is not treated as deaths occurring in that month. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.
sources.description_zh: 仅展示已审核 NMC 当前报告月全国全部通知计数，保留来源通知窗口；排除队列比较和患者状态分项，不将患者死亡状态视作当月发生的死亡。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Seuls les comptes nationaux NMC examinés de toutes les notifications du mois courant sont présentés, avec leur fenêtre source. Comparaisons de cohortes et sous-groupes par statut sont exclus ; le statut de décès ne devient pas un décès survenu ce mois-là. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.
sources.publisher: National Institute for Communicable Diseases (NICD), South Africa
sources.required_attribution: National Institute for Communicable Diseases (NICD), South Africa, South Africa NICD NMC. Original source: https://www.nicd.ac.za/nmc-overview/nmc-monthly-surveillance-report/. Source definitions and reporting periods retained.

sources.label: Argentina Ministry of Health Annual HIV Notifications
sources.description: Argentina Ministry of Health annual HIV notifications, 2014–2023. Each value is the source's explicit national ARG / 200 total for Ambos sexos; province and sex rows are not added. Notifications are not estimates of incident infections, prevalence or AIDS cases. Annual dates denote calendar years, not individual event dates; unknown values stay unknown. CC BY 4.0 is declared by the official resource metadata. The catalogue's older package description differs from the selected 2014–2023 resource. No 2024–2026 observations are supplied by this resource. BEN cumulative notifications remain a separate source and do not enter this curve.
sources.description_zh: 来源：阿根廷国家卫生部，2014–2023 年 HIV 年度通知数。每个数值直接取自来源明确给出的 ARG／200 全国、Ambos sexos 双性别合计行，不累加省份或性别分项。通知数不等于新感染估计、患病存量或 AIDS 病例；年度日期表示自然年，不是个案发生日期，未知值保持未知。官方资源元数据声明 CC BY 4.0；目录包较早的描述与所选 2014–2023 年原件范围不同。该资源尚无 2024–2026 年观测。BEN 累计通知保持独立来源，不混入本曲线。
sources.description_fr: Notifications annuelles de VIH du ministère argentin de la Santé, 2014–2023. Chaque valeur est le total national explicite ARG / 200 pour Ambos sexos ; les provinces et les sexes ne sont pas additionnés. Ces notifications ne mesurent ni les nouvelles infections estimées, ni la prévalence, ni les cas de sida. Les dates désignent des années civiles, pas des dates individuelles ; les valeurs inconnues restent inconnues. Les métadonnées officielles de la ressource déclarent CC BY 4.0. L'ancienne description du catalogue diffère de la ressource 2014–2023 sélectionnée, qui ne fournit aucune observation pour 2024–2026. Les cumuls BEN restent une source séparée, exclue de cette courbe.

sources.required_attribution: Ministerio de Salud de la Nación Argentina, Casos notificados de VIH por año y jurisdicción, 2014–2023, national ARG / 200, Ambos sexos. CC BY 4.0. Original resource: https://datos.salud.gob.ar/dataset/1f70534d-f5f0-41f7-bc9a-b9809c39a505/resource/747d2078-9d51-40d4-ae59-ced43225459f/download/casos_prov_vih_2014-2023_1.csv. Accessed 2026-11-16. source_info.notes: Report 506 national monthly notifications retain the source's mostly suspected case definition. Monthly reporting counts stay separate from DDS onset-week and report-week data; missing source periods remain unknown. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS weekly counts use onset date and place. They remain separate from report-date DDS Tableau and Report 506 monthly counts; only the reviewed onset definition is eligible. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS Tableau weekly counts use report date and place. They are a distinct source definition from onset-week DDS and monthly Report 506; the series are not combined into an additive total. sources.description_zh: Report 506 全国月度报告数保留来源以疑似病例为主的定义；月度报告数与 DDS 发病周、报告周数据分别保留，缺失期间保持未知。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les notifications nationales mensuelles du rapport 506 conservent la définition source, principalement des cas suspects. Elles restent distinctes des semaines de début et de notification DDS ; les périodes absentes restent inconnues. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

sources.description: Reviewed national DDS weekly counts use onset date and place. They remain separate from report-date DDS Tableau and Report 506 monthly counts; only the reviewed onset definition is eligible. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. sources.description_zh: 已审核全国 DDS 周度计数按发病日期及地点统计，与按报告日期统计的 DDS Tableau 及 Report 506 月度计数分别保留；仅采用已审核的发病口径。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les nombres hebdomadaires nationaux DDS examinés suivent la date et le lieu de début. Ils restent distincts du Tableau DDS par notification et des comptes mensuels du rapport 506 ; seule la définition examinée est retenue. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

Only the 18 reviewed count indicators are eligible; actual categories and available years vary by country. Annual data may lag and do not establish complete national surveillance coverage. WHO dataset terms permit public-health use with attribution; restrictions include commercial promotion, misrepresentation and implied endorsement. sources.label: INS SIVIGILA municipality records (2007–2022)
sources.description: Historical municipality-of-occurrence event/week counts, 2007–2022. These are not an official national weekly table. National aggregation and dated week boundaries require separate validation.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 市镇周汇总（2007–2022）
sources.description_zh: 2007–2022 年按发生地市镇、事件及周汇总的数据，并非官方全国周表。全国加总及周历边界须另行核验。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA successor municipality records (2022–2024)
sources.description: Separate successor open table covering 2022–2024; ingestion uses 2023–2024 and excludes the 2022 overlap. No 2025 or 2026 rows were present in the checked release. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation coverage.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 后续市镇周汇总（2022–2024）
sources.description_zh: 独立的后续开放表，实际覆盖 2022–2024 年；采集采用 2023–2024 年并排除重复的 2022 年。已检查版本没有 2025 或 2026 年数据，元数据更新时间不代表数据覆盖至今。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA annual microdata (through 2025)
sources.description: Annual workbooks through 2025; no 2026 workbook in the checked catalogue. Weekly aggregates derived from individual records retain source case classifications and foreign/unknown occurrence separately. Collective forms require event-specific measures. Derived notification counts are not a published INS national incidence table.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 年度微观数据（截至 2025）
sources.description_zh: 按统计年度发布的工作簿，已检查目录截至 2025 年，没有 2026 年表。个案按原始年周聚合，保留病例分类及境外、未知发生地；集体表须按事件核验指标。这是个案衍生的通知记录数，并非 INS 发布的全国周发病表。

sources.label: INS BES weekly bulletins (cumulative annex and weekly evidence)
sources.description: Reviewed body-table weekly notifications only. Annex year-to-date snapshots are separate and never weekly incidence; early issues without an explicit weekly definition remain gaps.
sources.label_zh: INS BES 周报（累计附录与当周证据）
sources.description_zh: 仅展示正文中明确单周定义的通知数。附录 Acumulado 累计数单独保存，不作周发病数；早期缺少明确周定义的报告保持缺口。

sources.label: INS event reports and surveillance methods
sources.description: Event-specific annual and epidemiological-period reports supply definitions and reconciliation evidence. They do not provide a complete multi-disease national weekly table and are not merged automatically.

source_info.notes: Report 506 national monthly notifications retain the source's mostly suspected case definition. Monthly reporting counts stay separate from DDS onset-week and report-week data; missing source periods remain unknown. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS weekly counts use onset date and place. They remain separate from report-date DDS Tableau and Report 506 monthly counts; only the reviewed onset definition is eligible. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS Tableau weekly counts use report date and place. They are a distinct source definition from onset-week DDS and monthly Report 506; the series are not combined into an additive total. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.

sources.label: Thailand DOE Report 506 Monthly History
sources.description: Report 506 national monthly notifications retain the source's mostly suspected case definition. Monthly reporting counts stay separate from DDS onset-week and report-week data; missing source periods remain unknown. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.
sources.description_zh: Report 506 全国月度报告数保留来源以疑似病例为主的定义；月度报告数与 DDS 发病周、报告周数据分别保留，缺失期间保持未知。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les notifications nationales mensuelles du rapport 506 conservent la définition source, principalement des cas suspects. Elles restent distinctes des semaines de début et de notification DDS ; les périodes absentes restent inconnues. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.
sources.publisher: Thailand Ministry of Public Health, Department of Disease Control
sources.required_attribution: Thailand Ministry of Public Health, Department of Disease Control, Thailand DOE Report 506 Monthly History. Original source: https://doe.moph.go.th/surdata/. Source definitions and reporting periods retained.

sources.label: Thailand DDS Weekly Onset Notifications
sources.description: Reviewed national DDS weekly counts use onset date and place. They remain separate from report-date DDS Tableau and Report 506 monthly counts; only the reviewed onset definition is eligible. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.
sources.description_zh: 已审核全国 DDS 周度计数按发病日期及地点统计，与按报告日期统计的 DDS Tableau 及 Report 506 月度计数分别保留；仅采用已审核的发病口径。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les nombres hebdomadaires nationaux DDS examinés suivent la date et le lieu de début. Ils restent distincts du Tableau DDS par notification et des comptes mensuels du rapport 506 ; seule la définition examinée est retenue. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

sources.description: Only reviewed current monthly all-notified national NMC counts are presented, retaining the source notification window. Cohort comparisons and patient-status subsets are excluded; patient death status is not treated as deaths occurring in that month. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.
sources.description_zh: 仅展示已审核 NMC 当前报告月全国全部通知计数，保留来源通知窗口；排除队列比较和患者状态分项，不将患者死亡状态视作当月发生的死亡。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Seuls les comptes nationaux NMC examinés de toutes les notifications du mois courant sont présentés, avec leur fenêtre source. Comparaisons de cohortes et sous-groupes par statut sont exclus ; le statut de décès ne devient pas un décès survenu ce mois-là. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

sources.label: Chile MINSAL Historical ENO Notifications
sources.description: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16. The official CKAN catalogue declares CC0. Only reviewed confirmed national annual notification aggregates are presented; individual case rows are not released. The current CSV covers 2007–2024 and a changed disease inventory, while the catalogue text and methodology PDF still describe 2007–2022 and older exclusions. This upstream discrepancy is retained in the source audit; the older PDF is not asserted to describe the current CSV. Notification year is not onset year. Source-system periods and classifications remain separate; absent disease-years are unknown.
sources.description_zh: 来源：智利卫生部，Notificaciones ENO；访问日期：2026-11-16。官方CKAN目录声明CC0。仅展示已审核的全国确诊年度通知汇总，不公开个案记录。当前CSV覆盖2007–2024年并含变化后的病种目录，而目录文字和方法PDF仍描述2007–2022年及旧排除范围；该上游差异保留审计，不将旧PDF视为当前CSV的完整说明。通知年份不等于发病年份，源系统时期和分类分别保留，缺失病种年份保持未知。
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Salud de Chile
sources.required_attribution: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16; national confirmed annual aggregates derived from the captured CSV, 2007–2024.

sources.label: Indonesia Ministry of Health Annual Health Profile
sources.description: Only explicitly national annual case totals in reviewed health-profile narrative tables are presented. Appendix column identities, rates, registered stock and classification subsets are not substituted for national case totals. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.
sources.description_zh: 仅展示已审核健康概况正文中明确标为全国的年度病例总数；附表列、率、登记存量及分类分项不替代全国病例总数。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Seuls les totaux annuels nationaux explicites des tableaux narratifs examinés du profil sanitaire sont présentés. Les annexes, taux, stocks enregistrés et sous-catégories ne remplacent pas les totaux nationaux. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.
sources.publisher: Ministry of Health of the Republic of Indonesia
sources.required_attribution: Ministry of Health of the Republic of Indonesia, Indonesia Ministry of Health Annual Health Profile. Original source: https://kemkes.go.id/id/profil-kesehatan-indonesia-2024. Source definitions and reporting periods retained.

source_info.notes: Report 506 national monthly notifications retain the source's mostly suspected case definition. sources.description_zh: Report 506 全国月度报告数保留来源以疑似病例为主的定义；月度报告数与 DDS 发病周、报告周数据分别保留，缺失期间保持未知。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les notifications nationales mensuelles du rapport 506 conservent la définition source, principalement des cas suspects. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

source_info.notes: Report 506 national monthly notifications retain the source's mostly suspected case definition. Monthly reporting counts stay separate from DDS onset-week and report-week data; missing source periods remain unknown. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS weekly counts use onset date and place. They remain separate from report-date DDS Tableau and Report 506 monthly counts; only the reviewed onset definition is eligible. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS Tableau weekly counts use report date and place. They are a distinct source definition from onset-week DDS and monthly Report 506; the series are not combined into an additive total. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.

sources.label: Thailand DOE Report 506 Monthly History
sources.description: Report 506 national monthly notifications retain the source's mostly suspected case definition. Monthly reporting counts stay separate from DDS onset-week and report-week data; missing source periods remain unknown. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.
sources.description_zh: Report 506 全国月度报告数保留来源以疑似病例为主的定义；月度报告数与 DDS 发病周、报告周数据分别保留，缺失期间保持未知。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les notifications nationales mensuelles du rapport 506 conservent la définition source, principalement des cas suspects. Elles restent distinctes des semaines de début et de notification DDS ; les périodes absentes restent inconnues. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.
sources.publisher: Thailand Ministry of Public Health, Department of Disease Control
sources.required_attribution: Thailand Ministry of Public Health, Department of Disease Control, Thailand DOE Report 506 Monthly History. Original source: https://doe.moph.go.th/surdata/. Source definitions and reporting periods retained.

sources.label: Thailand DDS Weekly Onset Notifications
sources.description: Reviewed national DDS weekly counts use onset date and place. They remain separate from report-date DDS Tableau and Report 506 monthly counts; only the reviewed onset definition is eligible. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.
sources.description_zh: 已审核全国 DDS 周度计数按发病日期及地点统计，与按报告日期统计的 DDS Tableau 及 Report 506 月度计数分别保留；仅采用已审核的发病口径。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les nombres hebdomadaires nationaux DDS examinés suivent la date et le lieu de début. Ils restent distincts du Tableau DDS par notification et des comptes mensuels du rapport 506 ; seule la définition examinée est retenue. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.
sources.publisher: Thailand Ministry of Public Health, Department of Disease Control
sources.required_attribution: Thailand Ministry of Public Health, Department of Disease Control, Thailand DDS Weekly Onset Notifications. Original source: https://doe.moph.go.th/dds-report/. Source definitions and reporting periods retained.

sources.label: Thailand DDS Tableau Weekly Report Notifications
sources.description: Reviewed national DDS Tableau weekly counts use report date and place. They are a distinct source definition from onset-week DDS and monthly Report 506; the series are not combined into an additive total. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.
sources.description_zh: 已审核全国 DDS Tableau 周度计数按报告日期及地点统计；与按发病周统计的 DDS 和 Report 506 月度数据具有不同来源定义，不合并相加。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les comptes hebdomadaires nationaux examinés du Tableau DDS suivent la date et le lieu de notification. Leur définition est distincte des semaines de début DDS et du rapport 506 mensuel ; les séries ne sont pas additionnées. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

source_info.notes: No same-structure national weekly open table exists for 2025–2026. Municipality products cover 2007–2022 and 2022–2024; selected BES weekly notifications, BES YTD snapshots, annual microdata and WHO laboratory detections remain independent, with different definitions and calendars.

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA municipality records (2007–2022)
sources.description: Historical municipality-of-occurrence event/week counts, 2007–2022. These are not an official national weekly table. National aggregation and dated week boundaries require separate validation.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 市镇周汇总（2007–2022）
sources.description_zh: 2007–2022 年按发生地市镇、事件及周汇总的数据，并非官方全国周表。全国加总及周历边界须另行核验。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA successor municipality records (2022–2024)
sources.description: Separate successor open table covering 2022–2024; ingestion uses 2023–2024 and excludes the 2022 overlap. No 2025 or 2026 rows were present in the checked release. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation coverage.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 后续市镇周汇总（2022–2024）
sources.description_zh: 独立的后续开放表，实际覆盖 2022–2024 年；采集采用 2023–2024 年并排除重复的 2022 年。已检查版本没有 2025 或 2026 年数据，元数据更新时间不代表数据覆盖至今。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA annual microdata (through 2025)
sources.description: Annual workbooks through 2025; no 2026 workbook in the checked catalogue. Weekly aggregates derived from individual records retain source case classifications and foreign/unknown occurrence separately. Collective forms require event-specific measures. Derived notification counts are not a published INS national incidence table.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 年度微观数据（截至 2025）
sources.description_zh: 按统计年度发布的工作簿，已检查目录截至 2025 年，没有 2026 年表。个案按原始年周聚合，保留病例分类及境外、未知发生地；集体表须按事件核验指标。这是个案衍生的通知记录数，并非 INS 发布的全国周发病表。

sources.label: INS BES weekly bulletins (cumulative annex and weekly evidence)
sources.description: Reviewed body-table weekly notifications only. Annex year-to-date snapshots are separate and never weekly incidence; early issues without an explicit weekly definition remain gaps.
sources.label_zh: INS BES 周报（累计附录与当周证据）
sources.description_zh: 仅展示正文中明确单周定义的通知数。附录 Acumulado 累计数单独保存，不作周发病数；早期缺少明确周定义的报告保持缺口。

sources.label: INS event reports and surveillance methods
sources.description: Event-specific annual and epidemiological-period reports supply definitions and reconciliation evidence. They do not provide a complete multi-disease national weekly table and are not merged automatically.
sources.label_zh: INS 单事件报告与监测方法
sources.description_zh: 按事件发布的年报及流行病学周期报告，用于核对病例定义、统计口径及总数，并非完整的全病种全国周表，不自动拼接为周曲线。

sources.label: WHO FluNet Colombia weekly laboratory detections
sources.description: Weekly respiratory laboratory detections; sentinel and nonsentinel retained separately, not national incident patient cases.
sources.label_zh: WHO FluNet 哥伦比亚实验室周检出数
sources.description_zh: 呼吸道实验室每周检出数；哨点与非哨点分别展示，不能解释为全国新发病例。

sources.label: Mexico DGE Annual Morbidity
sources.description: Reviewed national annual new-case totals include all ages and sexes. ICD revisions and source definitions are retained; rates, age/sex strata and subnational rows do not replace or add to national totals. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.
sources.description_zh: 展示已审核的全国、全年龄、全性别年度新报告病例总数，保留 ICD 版本及来源定义；率、年龄／性别分层和地方行不替代或累加到全国总数。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les totaux annuels nationaux examinés couvrent tous les âges et sexes. Les versions de la CIM et définitions sources sont conservées ; taux, strates et lignes infranationales ne remplacent ni ne complètent les totaux nationaux. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.
sources.publisher: Secretaría de Salud, Dirección General de Epidemiología (DGE)

source_info.notes: Report 506 national monthly notifications retain the source's mostly suspected case definition. Monthly reporting counts stay separate from DDS onset-week and report-week data; missing source periods remain unknown. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS weekly counts use onset date and place. They remain separate from report-date DDS Tableau and Report 506 monthly counts; only the reviewed onset definition is eligible. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. They are a distinct source definition from onset-week DDS and monthly Report 506; the series are not combined into an additive total. sources.description_zh: Report 506 全国月度报告数保留来源以疑似病例为主的定义；月度报告数与 DDS 发病周、报告周数据分别保留，缺失期间保持未知。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les notifications nationales mensuelles du rapport 506 conservent la définition source, principalement des cas suspects. Elles restent distinctes des semaines de début et de notification DDS ; les périodes absentes restent inconnues. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA municipality records (2007–2022)
sources.description: Historical municipality-of-occurrence event/week counts, 2007–2022. These are not an official national weekly table. National aggregation and dated week boundaries require separate validation.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 市镇周汇总（2007–2022）
sources.description_zh: 2007–2022 年按发生地市镇、事件及周汇总的数据，并非官方全国周表。全国加总及周历边界须另行核验。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA successor municipality records (2022–2024)
sources.description: Separate successor open table covering 2022–2024; ingestion uses 2023–2024 and excludes the 2022 overlap. No 2025 or 2026 rows were present in the checked release. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation coverage.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 后续市镇周汇总（2022–2024）
sources.description_zh: 独立的后续开放表，实际覆盖 2022–2024 年；采集采用 2023–2024 年并排除重复的 2022 年。已检查版本没有 2025 或 2026 年数据，元数据更新时间不代表数据覆盖至今。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA annual microdata (through 2025)
sources.description: Annual workbooks through 2025; no 2026 workbook in the checked catalogue. Weekly aggregates derived from individual records retain source case classifications and foreign/unknown occurrence separately. Collective forms require event-specific measures. Derived notification counts are not a published INS national incidence table.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 年度微观数据（截至 2025）
sources.description_zh: 按统计年度发布的工作簿，已检查目录截至 2025 年，没有 2026 年表。个案按原始年周聚合，保留病例分类及境外、未知发生地；集体表须按事件核验指标。这是个案衍生的通知记录数，并非 INS 发布的全国周发病表。

sources.label: INS BES weekly bulletins (cumulative annex and weekly evidence)
sources.description: Reviewed body-table weekly notifications only. Annex year-to-date snapshots are separate and never weekly incidence; early issues without an explicit weekly definition remain gaps.
sources.label_zh: INS BES 周报（累计附录与当周证据）
sources.description_zh: 仅展示正文中明确单周定义的通知数。附录 Acumulado 累计数单独保存，不作周发病数；早期缺少明确周定义的报告保持缺口。

sources.label: INS event reports and surveillance methods
sources.description: Event-specific annual and epidemiological-period reports supply definitions and reconciliation evidence. They do not provide a complete multi-disease national weekly table and are not merged automatically.
sources.label_zh: INS 单事件报告与监测方法

sources.label: Mexico WHO FluNet Weekly Respiratory Laboratory Surveillance
sources.description: Weekly respiratory laboratory surveillance. Detections, tests and positivity are separate measures; reporting networks, origins and subtypes overlap and must not be added or interpreted as national incident patient cases.

sources.required_attribution: World Health Organization, Global Influenza Surveillance and Response System. Mexico WHO FluNet Weekly Respiratory Laboratory Surveillance. Original source: https://www.who.int/tools/flunet. Source definitions, strata and periods retained.

sources.description: Source-published national incident notifications for the explicit reporting week or month. Cumulative totals, demographic strata and annual history remain separate. Missing cells remain unknown.
sources.description_zh: 按原表明确的报告周或月份展示全国新增报告数；累计数、人口分层与年度历史分别保留。缺失单元格保持未知。
sources.publisher: Secretaría de Salud, Dirección General de Epidemiología (DGE)
sources.required_attribution: Secretaría de Salud, Dirección General de Epidemiología (DGE). Mexico DGE Monthly Morbidity. Original source: https://epidemiologia.salud.gob.mx/anuario/html/morbilidad_nacional.html. Source definitions, strata and periods retained.

sources.label: Mexico DGE Annual Morbidity
sources.description: Reviewed national annual new-case totals include all ages and sexes. ICD revisions and source definitions are retained; rates, age/sex strata and subnational rows do not replace or add to national totals. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.
sources.description_zh: 展示已审核的全国、全年龄、全性别年度新报告病例总数，保留 ICD 版本及来源定义；率、年龄／性别分层和地方行不替代或累加到全国总数。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les totaux annuels nationaux examinés couvrent tous les âges et sexes. Les versions de la CIM et définitions sources sont conservées ; taux, strates et lignes infranationales ne remplacent ni ne complètent les totaux nationaux. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.
sources.publisher: Secretaría de Salud, Dirección General de Epidemiología (DGE)
sources.required_attribution: Secretaría de Salud, Dirección General de Epidemiología (DGE), Mexico DGE Annual Morbidity. Original source: https://epidemiologia.salud.gob.mx/anuario/html/index.html. Source definitions and reporting periods retained.

source_info.notes: Report 506 national monthly notifications retain the source's mostly suspected case definition. Monthly reporting counts stay separate from DDS onset-week and report-week data; missing source periods remain unknown. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS weekly counts use onset date and place. They remain separate from report-date DDS Tableau and Report 506 monthly counts; only the reviewed onset definition is eligible. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS Tableau weekly counts use report date and place. They are a distinct source definition from onset-week DDS and monthly Report 506; the series are not combined into an additive total. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.

sources.label: Thailand DOE Report 506 Monthly History
sources.description: Report 506 national monthly notifications retain the source's mostly suspected case definition. Monthly reporting counts stay separate from DDS onset-week and report-week data; missing source periods remain unknown. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.
sources.description_zh: Report 506 全国月度报告数保留来源以疑似病例为主的定义；月度报告数与 DDS 发病周、报告周数据分别保留，缺失期间保持未知。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les notifications nationales mensuelles du rapport 506 conservent la définition source, principalement des cas suspects. Elles restent distinctes des semaines de début et de notification DDS ; les périodes absentes restent inconnues. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.
sources.publisher: Thailand Ministry of Public Health, Department of Disease Control
sources.required_attribution: Thailand Ministry of Public Health, Department of Disease Control, Thailand DOE Report 506 Monthly History. Original source: https://doe.moph.go.th/surdata/. Source definitions and reporting periods retained.

sources.label: Thailand DDS Weekly Onset Notifications
sources.description: Reviewed national DDS weekly counts use onset date and place. They remain separate from report-date DDS Tableau and Report 506 monthly counts; only the reviewed onset definition is eligible. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.
sources.description_zh: 已审核全国 DDS 周度计数按发病日期及地点统计，与按报告日期统计的 DDS Tableau 及 Report 506 月度计数分别保留；仅采用已审核的发病口径。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les nombres hebdomadaires nationaux DDS examinés suivent la date et le lieu de début. Ils restent distincts du Tableau DDS par notification et des comptes mensuels du rapport 506 ; seule la définition examinée est retenue. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.
sources.publisher: Thailand Ministry of Public Health, Department of Disease Control
sources.required_attribution: Thailand Ministry of Public Health, Department of Disease Control, Thailand DDS Weekly Onset Notifications. Original source: https://doe.moph.go.th/dds-report/. Source definitions and reporting periods retained.

sources.description_fr: Les comptes hebdomadaires nationaux examinés du Tableau DDS suivent la date et le lieu de notification. source_info.notes: Report 506 national monthly notifications retain the source's mostly suspected case definition. Monthly reporting counts stay separate from DDS onset-week and report-week data; missing source periods remain unknown. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS weekly counts use onset date and place. They remain separate from report-date DDS Tableau and Report 506 monthly counts; only the reviewed onset definition is eligible. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms. Reviewed national DDS Tableau weekly counts use report date and place. They are a distinct source definition from onset-week DDS and monthly Report 506; the series are not combined into an additive total. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.

sources.description_zh: Report 506 全国月度报告数保留来源以疑似病例为主的定义；月度报告数与 DDS 发病周、报告周数据分别保留，缺失期间保持未知。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les notifications nationales mensuelles du rapport 506 conservent la définition source, principalement des cas suspects. Elles restent distinctes des semaines de début et de notification DDS ; les périodes absentes restent inconnues. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

sources.required_attribution: Thailand Ministry of Public Health, Department of Disease Control, Thailand DOE Report 506 Monthly History. Original source: https://doe.moph.go.th/surdata/. Source definitions and reporting periods retained.

sources.label: Thailand DDS Weekly Onset Notifications
sources.description: Reviewed national DDS weekly counts use onset date and place. They remain separate from report-date DDS Tableau and Report 506 monthly counts; only the reviewed onset definition is eligible. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.
sources.description_zh: 已审核全国 DDS 周度计数按发病日期及地点统计，与按报告日期统计的 DDS Tableau 及 Report 506 月度计数分别保留；仅采用已审核的发病口径。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Les nombres hebdomadaires nationaux DDS examinés suivent la date et le lieu de début. Ils restent distincts du Tableau DDS par notification et des comptes mensuels du rapport 506 ; seule la définition examinée est retenue. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.

sources.required_attribution: Thailand Ministry of Public Health, Department of Disease Control, Thailand DDS Weekly Onset Notifications. Original source: https://doe.moph.go.th/dds-report/. Source definitions and reporting periods retained.
